title: Identify the Common Factor
text:
In $2x^2(x + 3) + 3(x + 3)$:

- First term: $2x^2 \times (x + 3)$
- Second term: $3 \times (x + 3)$

The common factor is $(x + 3)$

title: Factor Out the Common Binomial
text:
Factor out $(x + 3)$:

$2x^2(x + 3) + 3(x + 3) = (x + 3)(2x^2 + 3)$

This is like factoring out a number, but we're factoring out a binomial expression.

title: Final Factorised Form
text:
The fully factorised form is:

$2x^3 + 6x^2 + 3x + 9 = (x + 3)(2x^2 + 3)$

Note: $(2x^2 + 3)$ cannot be factorised further over the real numbers.
